page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance belonging to the ecs.c7a family, powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 32 physical AMD EPYC 7T83 cores running at 2.55 GHz with 2 threads per core. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate strong multi-core and single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng scores placing the instance in the top 25%. It demonstrates high efficiency in cryptographic operations, database operations, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, all ranking in the top tier. Memory performance is mixed; while cached small-block read-only bandwidth is strong, uncached large-block read and write bandwidths fall into the average range. Ray tracing and image processing benchmarks also show strong performance, whereas software compilation, text processing, and Redis SET operations perform at average levels.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high compute-to-memory ratio make this instance profile suitable for CPU-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. The hardware configuration is well-suited for multi-threaded data processing, database operations, cryptography tasks, and light machine learning inference, such as prompt processing and text generation using smaller models.
